title: Repository developer experience guidance governance
purpose: Define non-implementation guidance contracts for selected developer-experience repository optimisation items while preserving USF authority, proof, evidence, and validation boundaries.

coveredIssues.title: Local timing dashboard
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The local timing dashboard design identifies metrics, artifact format, display mode, and no-claim wording. Dependencies USF-384 and USF-415 are Done.

coveredIssues.title: Cache clean command
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The cache clean command contract identifies cache classes, ownership, safety class, and validation after cleanup. Dependency USF-616 is Done.

coveredIssues.title: Proof artifact viewer
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The proof artifact viewer design states viewed artifact classes, source links, non-claims, and freshness display. Dependencies USF-598 and USF-633 are Done.

coveredIssues.title: IDE and editor recommended settings
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The editor recommendation identifies safe settings, risks, and files to avoid editing automatically. The issue has no dependencies.

coveredIssues.title: Pre-commit and pre-push policy decision
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The decision-preparation packet presents options, recommendation, owner approval need, and no-regression path. Dependency USF-639 is Done.

coveredIssues.title: One-command setup
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The setup command contract states prerequisites, command contract, outputs, cache behaviour, and failure modes. Dependency USF-398 is Done.

coveredIssues.title: Doctor and preflight command
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The doctor and preflight contract defines checks, outputs, exit codes, and non-claims. Dependencies USF-418 and USF-419 are Done.

coveredIssues.title: Fast validate command
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The fast validate contract states included checks, excluded checks, escalation triggers, and outputs. Dependencies USF-386 and USF-398 are Done.

coveredIssues.title: Explain-failure output
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The failure output standard defines failure sections, required evidence links, and exit-code semantics. Dependency USF-414 is Done.

coveredIssues.title: Make target help
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The Make target help design lists required metadata fields and generation approach. Dependency USF-411 is Done.

coveredIssues.title: Repository onboarding guide
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The onboarding guide outline identifies audience, required commands, authority references, and validation expectations. Dependency USF-675 is Done.

coveredIssues.title: Contributor command guide
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The contributor command guide outline maps change types to commands and identifies missing commands to create in separate issues. Dependencies USF-398 and USF-675 are Done.

coveredIssues.title: AI-agent operating guide improvement
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The AI-agent guide proposal identifies guide changes and confirms no conflict with agent directive files. Dependency USF-675 is Done.

coveredIssues.title: Common failure remediation guide
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The failure remediation guide outline maps failures to safe commands, evidence preservation notes, and owner decisions. Dependency USF-699 is covered by this artefact.

coveredIssues.title: AI-agent task checklist
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The AI-agent task checklist proposal references required authority files and validation expectations. Dependency USF-701 is covered by this artefact.

coveredIssues.title: New developer onboarding test
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The onboarding test design states scenario, commands, expected outputs, timing capture, and non-claims. Dependencies USF-699, USF-714, and USF-715 are covered or Done.

coveredIssues.title: Environment reset command
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The environment reset command contract distinguishes safe reset, test reset, and destructive cleanup. Dependency USF-596 is Done.

coveredIssues.title: Safe clean command
coveredIssues.completionBasis: The safe clean command contract lists what is removed, preserved, warned, and blocked by default. Dependencies USF-422 and USF-596 are Done.
